verdict.rationale: 2FAS's own llms.txt states 'Public API: None', and no OpenAPI spec exists at any candidate path, so there is no documented programmatic surface for an agent to create or update vault entries or seed TOTP secrets. Manual file imports and the 2FAS API, which lets online services offer one-click 2FA enablement, are adjacent features and do not provide agent-driven vault writes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can create and update vault entries — seeding new TOTP secrets, storing credentials — through documented programmatic surfaces
